Abstract. This guide describes the total rewards package at Nexora Technologies. It explains how gross salary is
structured, the contribution rules of the provident fund and gratuity, medical and life insurance limits by grade, allowances for
fuel, learning and on-call duty, and other benefits such as festival bonuses and salary advances. Limits are expressed in
Pakistani Rupees (PKR) and vary by employee grade (G1 to G6).
Keywords: benefits, salary structure, provident fund, gratuity, medical insurance, allowances, bonus
1. Compensation Structure
Gross monthly salary consists of four components, shown in Figure 1. Taxes are deducted at source under the
Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 and are reported on the monthly payslip. Salary is credited on the last working day
of each month.
Figure 1. Composition of gross monthly salary.
2. Retirement and Termination Benefits
2.1 Provident Fund
Every confirmed employee contributes 8% of basic salary to the Nexora Provident Fund, and the company
contributes a matching 8%. The employee's own contribution is always fully owned; ownership of the company's
contribution increases with service, as in Table 1.

2.2 Gratuity and EOBI
Employees who complete at least 1 year of service receive gratuity of one month's last drawn basic salary for
each completed year of service, payable in the final settlement. Nexora also registers all eligible employees
with EOBI and the provincial social security institution as required by law.
3. Medical and Life Insurance
Nexora provides group health insurance from the first day of joining. Cover extends to the employee, spouse
and up to 3 dependent children. Parents may be added for grades G3 and above, with the additional premium
deducted from salary. Table 2 lists limits per policy year.

Treatment is cashless at panel hospitals; for non-panel hospitals the employee pays and submits a claim within
30 days of discharge. Pre-existing conditions are covered from day one. Group life insurance provides a benefit
of 36 times monthly basic salary in the event of death in service.

5. Bonuses and Recognition
• Festival bonus: 50% of basic salary paid before each Eid (Eid ul-Fitr and Eid ul-Adha) to confirmed
employees.
• Annual performance bonus: a company-wide bonus pool is funded when the company meets its revenue
and profit targets; individual payouts follow the rating scale in the Employee Handbook.
• Referral bonus: PKR 50,000 for each successful engineering hire (PKR 25,000 for other roles), paid after
the new joiner completes 3 months.
• Long-service award: a cash award and additional day of leave at 5 and 10 years of service.
6. Salary Advance and Loans
After confirmation, an employee may request an interest-free salary advance of up to 2 months' gross salary
for emergencies, recoverable in up to 12 monthly instalments. Only one advance may be outstanding at a time.
Requests are approved by the line manager and Head of HR and paid within 5 working days.
7. Enrolment and Changes
New employees must complete benefits enrolment in the HRMS portal within 30 days of joining. Dependants
can be added or removed later only after a qualifying life event (marriage, birth or adoption of a child, death or
divorce) and within 30 days of the event. Questions about claims should be sent to the benefits desk at
benefits@nexora.example.
